description: Bypass: bypasses the modules at the far ends of its cables, by button or by CV

params.text: Pressing it turns the bypass state on or off and it glows red while that state is on; with momentary mode set, it inverts the state only while it is held
Sets what the trigger input does: dark, a rising edge toggles the bypass state; green, a high gate turns the bypass on and a low gate turns it off; red, that gate is inverted
Sets which modules at the source end of the cable patched into its input are bypassed: none, the source alone, or the source with its unbroken neighbours to the left, to the right, or both ways
Sets which modules at the far end of the cable patched into its output are bypassed: none, the target alone, or the target with its unbroken neighbours to the left, to the right, or both ways
Sets what the trigger button does: dark, each press toggles the bypass state; yellow, a press inverts the bypass state only while the button is held

inputs.text: A trigger or gate that changes the bypass state, read as a Schmitt trigger going high at 2V and low at 0.1V; the G button sets which of the two it is
Passes every channel patched here through to the output it is paired with, and is the route by which the source module is bypassed

outputs.text: Carries the channels of the input it is paired with; while that input is unpatched the cable here has no channels, which the destination treats as no cable and so keeps its own normalled value

notes: a run of neighbours ends at a gap, at another Bypass module, or at a Venom Blocker, and none of those three is included in it
nothing is bypassed until a cable runs between one of its pairs and the module concerned; from new each output bypasses the module it feeds and each input bypasses nothing

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
